title: Sheldrake's TED Talk censored and taken off YouTube

tellings.quote: in 2013 rert sheldrick's Ted Talk was censored and taken off YouTube

plain: Jesse Michels says that in 2013 a TED Talk, one of the popular short lectures from the TED conference, given by the biologist Rupert Sheldrake was censored and taken off YouTube. Michels states this himself, without naming a source, while introducing Sheldrake as a scientist pushed aside for ideas outside the mainstream.
